description: Subscriber removal action in directory, edge-to-edge popup advert live preview alignment, and button placement position toggle.
author: Conspodium Core Team
highlights: Added 1-click Subscriber Deletion action in the Subscriber Directory with confirmation dialog and live list refreshing
